reasoning_content:
The backup service is running with the crontab schedule loaded. Let me verify:
1. The list of migration names (the primary key is `name`, so I'll query by name)
2. The contents of the backup volume (the .age file)
3. The ML model cache volume (the 4.6GB model)
4. Whether the worker is healthy

action.command: cd /workspace && docker compose exec -T postgres psql -U daz -d daz -c "SELECT name FROM kysely_migration ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 12;" 2>&1
